messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for service=edge-router, target=canary-v2, cohort=eu-west, traffic=5% -> 20% over 15m window. release_id=rel_2025_04_12_02 :rocket:
anya-eng: copying release notes to #release-notes. pinned config: `edge-router:v2` for canary only.
sre-juniper: seeing p95 spike from 120ms -> 400ms on eu-west canary nodes, not on us-west. digging. :mag_right:
mike-runtime: can you paste the LB split command you used? want to double-check affinity rules.
anya-eng: command was:
```
routerctl traffic-split set --service edge-router --from v1.9.3 --to v2 --region eu-west --percent 20 --sticky session_cookie
```
carla-release: noted. if affinity sticky=true we might be warming long tails, could explain p95. suggest pause at 10% and revert sticky to false for canary.
sre-juniper: confirm errors? logs show a small increase in 502s from a specific host pool (eu-west-3a). stacktrace points to connection pool exhaustion. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by @sre-juniper at 1755554380. current traffic eu-west=20% (canary), health=DEGRADED, fallthrough policy=hold.
anya-eng: rolling back traffic to pinned v1.9.3 for eu-west. executing fast drain + immediate re-pin.
ops-ivy: issuing rollback command now:
```
routerctl traffic-split set --service edge-router --from v2 --to v1.9.3 --region eu-west --percent 0 --force
```
carla-release: updating release notes: "hotfix: revert v2 canary due to connection-pool regression under session-sticky in eu-west. Investigating keepalive behavior."
mike-runtime: monitoring for error decay, will report p95/p99, tokenization latency and open sockets metric.
sre-juniper: 502s falling back to baseline after drain starts, host eu-west-3a shows connection_count spiked then recovered. put task on infra: increase ephemeral pool by 30% for next canary run.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 1755554689. traffic eu-west now pinned to v1.9.3. status=rolled_back. :white_check_mark:
anya-eng: creating follow-up: add repro steps, attach perf trace and curl logs. assign to @mike-runtime and @carla-release. change window note: extend quiet-window for next attempt to 90m.
carla-release: brief postmortem template: cause hypothesis, mitigation (disable sticky + pool bump), next steps (observability alert for pool saturation), owner list. will publish in #postmortems after triage.
ops-ivy: thumbs for rollback speed :thumbsup: please file a ticket for regression test that runs canary under sticky sessions.
mike-runtime: ACK, will also add an automated pre-canary smoke that exercises long-pinned sessions.
anya-eng: final: marking release rel_2025_04_12_02 as failed-canary, updating release dashboard. good catch everyone.
